channel.title: 52 at 52 · 52 km a week
channel.description: Season 2 of 52@52: 52 credited km every week (run km + ride km / 2). New activities, completed weeks, summaries and reviews.

item.title: Week 2 · Activity 1: A Little Beyond a Half, with Paula Alongside
item.description:
Run · 22.45 km · 2:14:04

A steady 22.45 km run on Coyote Creek Trail, with Paula on the bike, perfect temperatures, and enough energy to finish feeling good.

Uma corrida de 22,45 km na Coyote Creek Trail, com a Paula de bicicleta, temperatura perfeita e disposição até o final.

item.title: Week 2 · Activity 2: New Country, Same 52 km Mission
item.description:
Run · 15.64 km · 1:35:37

A solo 15.64 km run along the Aracaju waterfront after traveling to Brazil, with some welcome clouds and the end of an audiobook that won me over.

Uma corrida solo de 15,64 km pela orla de Aracaju depois da viagem ao Brasil, com nuvens bem-vindas e o final de um audiolivro que me conquistou.

item.title: Week 2 · Activity 3: A Wrong Turn, an Extra Few Kilometers, and Coconut Water
item.description:
Run · 16.97 km · 1:48:16

A planned run of almost 15 km became a 16.97 km exploration of Aracaju, followed by a walk home and cold coconut water to celebrate completing Week 2.

Um percurso planejado de quase 15 km virou uma exploração de 16,97 km por Aracaju, com caminhada de volta e água de coco gelada para comemorar a conclusão da Semana 2.

item.description:

Season 2 kicks off with a 30 km trail race (well, 28.69 km according to my watch), 660 m of climbing, two great friends, a sneaky rock in my shoe, and a podium mystery.

A temporada 2 começa com uma corrida de trilha de 30 km (bom, 28,69 km segundo o meu relógio), 660 m de subida, dois grandes amigos, uma pedrinha atrevida no tênis e um mistério no pódio.

item.description:
